metadata.mode: READ-ONLY / NO IMPLEMENTATION / NO NEW MODULE / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.objective: Determine if Human-needed Evidence Relations can be expressed by existing Evidence Facts

executive_summary.finding: 4/8 Relations fully expressible, 2/8 partially, 2/8 not expressible, 1/8 not a Relation (L4)
executive_summary.key_discovery: TLD already computes table.headers, table.rows, a_cell, b_cell — but compute_is11_observation() compresses them to boolean (is_in_table, different_cell), discarding structural relation data
executive_summary.gap_type: DISTILLATION_GAP (for expressible relations) + MISSING_OBSERVATION (for RC2/RC3 — text block segmentation)
executive_summary.conclusion: NO NEW MODULE — Relations can be derived evidence representations / research metadata

relation_definition.R1_multi_evidence_dependency: Must depend on >=2 Evidence Facts or 1 Fact + 1 Context
relation_definition.R2_relational_meaning: Output must describe structural relation between evidence, not copy a field
relation_definition.R3_traceability: Must trace back to Input Evidence IDs → Original Evidence → Source

fact_vs_relation_boundary.same_y_band: FACT — native geometry observation (dy=0), not a Relation
fact_vs_relation_boundary.different_cell: FACT (derived from Relation) — TLD computes a_cell != b_cell → boolean. Original Relation data (a_cell, b_cell) was compressed.
fact_vs_relation_boundary.A_B_vertical_groups: RELATION (L3) — can be derived from TLD table.rows column extraction

tld_outputs.table.headers: List of column header strings (e.g., ["model", "top-1 err.", "top-5 err."])
tld_outputs.table.rows: List of rows, each row = list of cell values

compute_is11_observation_returns.is_in_table: bool (derived from a_cell is not None)
compute_is11_observation_returns.table_info.a_cell: (row, col) — exists but NOT used in Cue
compute_is11_observation_returns.table_info.b_cell: (row, col) — exists but NOT used in Cue

tld_discarded_data.implication: Column Position Relation data was COMPUTED but DISCARDED in Cue construction — Distillation Gap, not Observation Gap

RC1.derivation: search text_a/b in table.rows → (row,col) → headers[col] → structural position
RC1.output: A is in column 6 (header: top-1 err.), B is in column 7 (header: top-5 err.), same row, adjacent columns

RC5.derivation: extract column items from table.rows at A/B column indices
RC5.output: A aligns vertically with [B6, 83.95, 84.04, ...]; B aligns with [., B7, 84.26, ...]
RC5.pattern_boundary: DETECTED — approaches Pattern but stays within single table (L3)

RC6.derivation: compare is_in_table vs ends_period → conflict; compare different_cell vs ends_period → conflict

RC8.derivation: sort line_spans by x0 → extract items before A and after B
RC8.output: A has left neighbor "1. Introduction"; B has right neighbor (none)

necessity.RC1: NECESSARY — 22 cases affected; TLD data exists but discarded
necessity.RC2: NECESSARY — caused A/B disagreement; but not expressible
necessity.RC3: HELPFUL — only 2 cases; FIG marker already available
necessity.RC5: HELPFUL — useful but approaches Pattern boundary
necessity.RC7: HELPFUL — individual facts already exist as cues

missing_information.RC7: PARTIAL (facts exist, type classification is interpretation)
missing_information.key_distinction: RC1/RC5/RC6/RC8 = MISSING_RELATION_ORGANIZATION (not new observation). RC2/RC3 = MISSING_OBSERVATION (text block segmentation).
missing_information.shared_missing_observation: RC2 and RC3 share the same missing observation: TEXT_BLOCK/REGION segmentation. Affects only 6/30 cases. P722 B1 still 100% on these cases (image sufficient).

semantic_boundary.rule: L4 is excluded from Evidence Relation layer

pattern_boundary.description: Single-table column extraction = L3 Relation. Cross-table aggregation = Pattern = FORBIDDEN.
pattern_boundary.action: STOP — do not design Pattern Engine

rule_leakage.explanation: Relations describe structural positions/conflicts, not decisions. Rule leakage only occurs if someone writes code: if relation → decision. AUTHORITY=0 prevents this.

example_1_AMB-024.evidence_relation: A in col 6 (top-1 err.), B in col 7 (top-5 err.), same row, adjacent

anti_overdesign.conclusion: A and F are True → NO NEW MODULE, NO NEW CORE OBJECT

recommended_direction.for_expressible_relations: Problem is Distillation Gap — compute_is11_observation() discards TLD headers/rows/cell positions. Not Architecture Gap.
recommended_direction.for_inexpressible_relations: RC2/RC3 share MISSING_OBSERVATION (text block segmentation). Affects 6/30 cases. P722 B1 still 100% (image sufficient). Not worth new module.
recommended_direction.for_RC4: Content Type is L4 Interpretation, not Evidence Relation. Should not be forced into Relation layer.
recommended_direction.for_RC5: PATTERN_BOUNDARY_DETECTED. Stays at L3. Do not design Pattern Engine.
recommended_direction.overall: NO NEW MODULE. Relations are derived evidence representations / research metadata.

confidence.RC1_fully_expressible: HIGH — AMB-024 verified: headers[6]="top-1 err.", headers[7]="top-5 err."
confidence.RC2_not_expressible: HIGH — P1-P6 + TLD have no text block segmentation
confidence.tld_cell_position_has_error: MEDIUM — a_cell=(3,1) but actual position is row 7 col 6

limitations: TLD cell position assignment has误差 (a_cell does not always match actual position)
TLD coverage 41% (10/30 cases have cell data), non-TLD pages cannot express RC1/RC5
n=1 participant (P722), Human need assessment based on limited sample
Cannot verify if Relation actually improves Human judgment (experiment forbidden)
RC2/RC3 MISSING_OBSERVATION only documented, not evaluated for implementation cost

final_answers.Q2_minimal_relation: deterministic composition: search text in TLD rows → (row,col) → headers[col]; compare cues for conflicts; sort line_spans for neighbors
final_answers.Q4_missing_info: TEXT_BLOCK/REGION segmentation (shared by RC2+RC3). Affects 6/30. Image already compensates.
final_answers.Q5_enter_core: NO — Relations are derived representations / research metadata. No persistence, no frozen baseline, no runtime, no API contract needed.
